You also see someone who seems to be the leader of them sitting leisurely with a bored look as he watches his friends bullies.

Right next to him, an Omega clings to his arm, acting spoiled. But suddenly, they are distracted by your sweet pheromone, which you didn't realize were reaching their nostrils. At first, they thought it was the sweet smell of Derick's vape smoke, until they realized it was your presence that brought that sweet scent.

"Look, isn't that the transfer student? I heard they're from that rare clan." One of them says, pointing at you. Another steps toward you and teasesd, "Looks like this little one is lost. Did you know your pheromones can be so dangerous for you, sweetie?”

In an instant, they forgot about their bullying, including the leader Derick himself, who watches you from his place as one of his followers approaches you.
